parsed.rationale: All three records — `PlaylistSectionHeader` in `PlaylistView.swift`, `TextRowView` in `TextRowView.swift`, and `FittingText` in `InfoDetailView.swift` — are `type-alias-object` kinds within the same `app:iOS` package and share 2 fields according to `shared_field_count: 2`, indicating they alias the same underlying SwiftUI view shape. Because all three live in `app:iOS` and no restraint markers are set, consolidating them into a single canonical type alias (retaining the most semantically neutral name `FittingText`) in a shared Views utility file eliminates the three-way duplication. The two aliases in `PlaylistView.swift` and `TextRowView.swift` can then be removed or replaced with imports of the canonical definition.
